examples.title: Verify a signed PDF (no chain trust)
Verify with a trusted root certificate

description: Read-only verification of every signature: ByteRange digest vs CMS messageDigest (integrity), CMS signatureValue vs the embedded signer certificate (RSA-SHA256/384/512, ECDSA P-256), chain trust when trustedRootsDerBase64 is given ('self-signed' | 'unverified' | 'trusted' otherwise). /DocTimeStamp entries are verified as RFC 3161 tokens and count in allValid like any signature. Result: { allValid, signatureCount, summary, signatures:[{ valid, integrity, signerSubject, signingTime, chainTrust, errors[] }] }. `ltv:true` adds the PAdES view: per-signature profile, timestamp, revocation (read from embedded /DSS only — responder signatures are not re-verified) and ltvLevel B-B / B-T / B-LT / B-LTA with explicit caveats. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary', fields:['allValid'].

fields.description: Optional dot-path projection applied to the structured result (e.g. ['allValid'] or ['signatures.valid']). Composes after verbosity. Unknown paths are omitted.

ltv.description: Add the PAdES view: per signature profile, timestamp, revocation (embedded /DSS only), ltvLevel (B-B / B-T / B-LT / B-LTA); document-level dss, ltvLevel, caveats.

password.description: Password (user or owner) of an encrypted source. Never logged or echoed.

trustedRootsDerBase64.description: Optional list of base64-encoded X.509 root certificates (DER). When supplied, each signer certificate is validated against these roots; otherwise chainTrust is reported as self-signed or unverified.

verbosity.description: Response verbosity. 'full' (default) returns the per-signature signatures[] array; 'summary' returns a token-frugal verdict { signatureCount, allValid, invalid, summary } (+ ltvLevel when ltv:true) and drops signatures[], dss and caveats.

name: verify_pdf

outputSchema.description: Structured signature verification result. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

allValid.description: true when the document carries at least one signature and every entry of signatures[] — CMS signatures and /DocTimeStamp tokens alike — is valid (integrity + signature check + chain trust when trustedRootsDerBase64 is given). A tampered document timestamp fails the verdict; a sound one never does.

caveats.description: ltv only. Fixed statements about what the LTV evaluation does not cover.

dss.description: ltv only. Document Security Store summary, or null when the catalog has no /DSS.

vriKeys.description: /VRI dictionary keys (uppercase-hex SHA-1 of each covered signature /Contents).

invalid.description: summary only: number of invalid signatures.

ltvLevel.description: ltv only. Minimum level across non-timestamp signatures ('B-B' when there are none).

isDocTimestamp.description: Present (true) only for /DocTimeStamp entries: the RFC 3161 token imprint is checked against the ByteRange digest and the token SignerInfo against the embedded TSA certificate.

ltvLevel.description: ltv only. PAdES baseline level reached by this signature.

profile.description: ltv only. 'pades' when the CMS carries ESS signing-certificate-v2 (RFC 5035).

revocation.description: ltv only. Signer revocation status read from embedded /DSS material; responder signatures are not verified.

signerSubject.description: Signer CN (TSA CN for document timestamps).

signingTime.description: /M as stored, or the TSTInfo genTime (ISO 8601) for document timestamps.

subFilter.description: /SubFilter of the signature dictionary (adbe.pkcs7.detached, ETSI.CAdES.detached, ETSI.RFC3161, …).

timestamp.description: ltv only. RFC 3161 signature timestamp (id-aa-signatureTimeStampToken) carried in the unsigned attributes.

imprintVerified.description: Token messageImprint equals the digest of the signature value.

tokenSignatureValid.description: The token's own CMS signature verifies against the TSA certificate it carries (null when it could not be evaluated). Required for B-T.

title: Verify PDF signatures
